title: Add third party smart watches like source of data.
body:
Hi,
Please add third party smart watches like a data sources. Huawei health app on my phone read data from phone, but apple health app doesn’t read my gt3 or other smart watches from huawei.
In my point of view it’s very stupid.
author: dimpex_01

title: Disgusting!!!!!
body:
I do not know who is responsible but Medications tab is not available in Bulgaria(Member of EU). Why would someone restrict it… I have 10 different prescribed medicines that I have to take in a very difficult to remember pattern and I was amazed Apple has that feature to set up reminders specifically for medicine… well i was amazed until now. This is a huge draw back. I switched to iPhone 13, roughly6 months ago and I still do not get all the hype from apple fan girls and bois… for the same price I would have gotten better Android phone with working features. Extremely disappointed and this was a huge nail in the coffin of my reconsideration of going back to Android once this 13ProMax becomes obsolete.

Edit: 2 weeks later medications tab is available. Kudos for the quick silent response.
